name: braintrust
summary: I successfully installed the Braintrust SDK and dependencies (`braintrust-0.35.0`, `autoevals-0.3.0`, `openai`) and wrote the `movie_matcher.py` eval script exactly per the quickstart, adapting it to use the Braintrust Gateway with the provided `BRAINTRUST_API_KEY`. However, the sandbox has a fundamental outbound network connectivity issue: every HTTPS connection is reset during the TLS handshake, as demonstrated by `curl` tests to `gateway.braintrust.dev`, `api.braintrust.dev`, and even `google.com` all returning `Connection reset by peer`. Because of this, the Python script cannot reach either the Braintrust API or the Gateway to run the LLM calls, so no eval run could be executed and no scores were reported. The setup is complete and correct, but the network block makes the promised outcome impossible to verify.
